mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_outbox (event_type, event_version, aggregate_id, payload, trace_id) VALUES (#{eventType}, #{eventVersion}, #{aggregateId,jdbcType=OTHER}, CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb), #{traceId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_type, event_version, aggregate_id, payload::text AS payload_json, trace_id, created_at, attempts FROM sys_outbox WHERE published_at IS NULL AND failed_at IS NULL AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY next_attempt_at, created_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
